<style>

function openAu(k,i){const a=AI[k][i];lbi.src=a[0];lbi.alt=a[1];lbc.textContent=a[1];lb.showModal()}
function openSa(k,i){const a=SA[k][i];lbi.src=a[0];lbi.alt="Analytics: "+a[1];lbc.textContent=a[1];lb.showModal()}
function openCa(k){const a=CA[k];lbi.src=a[0];lbi.alt=a[1];lbc.textContent=a[1];lb.showModal()}
function openImg(k){const n=C.find(c=>c[2]===k)[0];lbi.src=IM[k];lbi.alt=n+" website screenshot";lbc.textContent=n;lb.showModal()}
